status: locked before 21styear and tunnel outcomes were computed
scope: all eligible intact single-run narratives in the local ds002345 v1.1.4 candidate scan

primary_extension.feature_transform: scaler and five-component PCA fitted only on the original eight development stories
primary_extension.projection: all five evaluation stories projected without refitting
primary_extension.primary_unit: mean delta cv_r across the 17 predefined ROIs for each story

leave_one_story_out_pca_sensitivity.feature_transform: for each fold, fit a story-balanced scaler and five-component PCA to cumulative-context embeddings from the other 12 stories and project the omitted story without refitting
leave_one_story_out_pca_sensitivity.story_balance: use every available training TR while giving each training story equal total weight; scaler moments and covariance contributions are averaged across stories rather than pooled across all TRs
leave_one_story_out_pca_sensitivity.temporal_sampling: no beginning, middle, ending, or other outcome-dependent segment is selected and no story is truncated to the shortest duration

leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.training: fit ROI encoding coefficients on the shared responses from 12 stories and evaluate the complete omitted story
leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.feature_transform: use the corresponding story-balanced leave-one-story-out scaler and five-component PCA
leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.story_balance: all training TRs are retained and each training story receives equal total sample weight through per-TR weights proportional to one divided by that story's retained TR count
leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.target_handling: detrend and standardize each training-story shared response separately using only that story; detrend and standardize the omitted-story target using the omitted story without using predictor information
leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.contrast: held-out-story prediction correlation difference between the combined and rich-audio models
leave_one_story_out_encoding_sensitivity.interpretation: exploratory full-story stimulus-transfer analysis; it is distinct from within-story forward-chaining prediction

interpretation_constraints: The 13-story pooled analysis is combined evidence, not an independent replication.
Leave-one-story-out PCA holds the stimulus out of feature-space fitting but does not train the neural encoding coefficients on the other 12 stories.
The separate leave-one-story-out encoding sensitivity does train neural coefficients on the other 12 stories and gives every training story equal total weight.
The two new intact stories will remain in all reports regardless of sign or statistical significance.
No temporally scrambled task will be substituted for an intact narrative after outcomes are known.
